name: adv_rl_sb3_clean
title: Stable-Baselines3 PPO training script - correct, and almost entirely invisible
origin: written for the domain-generative-rl-graph hardening round, 2026-09-13
note: A correct framework-owned training script. It carries no `expected` row and must carry no finding. Its value is the coverage claim, not the rule set: on this file MLView recovers 5 nodes and 2 edges from 18 call sites, reports `model`, `train`, `eval` and `deliver` as not detected, emits **no** diagnostic of any kind, and its answer card prints `No findings: no rule fired on this workspace`. See finding DGRG-01; that misrepresentation is what this program exists to pin.

forbidden.why: there is no hand-written training loop here at all - model.learn() owns the update
there is no hand-written training loop here at all
evaluation is EvalCallback plus evaluate_policy(deterministic=True); SB3 handles the mode switch
evaluation is owned by SB3, which runs its rollouts under torch.no_grad() internally
device placement is SB3's job; this file never touches a tensor
random.seed, np.random.seed and stable_baselines3.common.utils.set_random_seed are all called at lines 52-54, and PPO(..., seed=SEED) is passed at line 68
there is no split call in this project - training and evaluation use two separate environments
checkpointing is model.save()/PPO.load(), not torch.save of a module or a bare torch.load

unsupported.defect: not a defect - a correct one-million-step training run
unsupported.why: recorded here because MLView draws no node for it, puts nothing in the `train` stage, and emits no diagnostic. Any rule that wanted to reason about this program's training loop has nothing to reason about.
